findings.what: The blocking coverage gate is still a live dispatch-completions liveness reader that accepts unsigned ok:true records. In evaluate(), roleRecs only requires role, ok:true, dispatch_id, cmdline_checksum, optional shape/plan item, current argv_schema_version, and artifact proof; it never calls attest-signing.verifyRecord.
findings.why: A hand-authored unsigned record with fake dispatch_id/cmdline_checksum/current argv_schema_version/output_digest satisfies the gate and returns ok:true. This leaves a remaining false-green path outside gauntlet-verify/applyPanelGate/verifyTyped and invalidates the claim that no other live liveness reader omits signature verification.
